title: Fund shared definitions
description: Shared primitive types for the portfolio decision journal. Pattern-based throughout: nothing here relies on JSON Schema 'format', which is annotation-only by default and would silently pass malformed values.

uuid7.description: UUIDv7 -- time-ordered, so identifiers sort by creation. Version nibble is 7 and the variant nibble is 8/9/a/b.

issuerId.description: Legal issuing entity. GOOG and GOOGL share one issuer_id. Hand-maintained in v0, so the form is readable rather than opaque.

securityId.description: A distinct security of an issuer (a share class). Survives ticker changes and delistings.

listingId.description: A security's listing on one venue. Delisting closes the listing, never the security.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code. Minor-unit integers are not accepted anywhere in this system.

decimalString.description: Canonical exact decimal string: no leading zero (except the integer 0 itself), no trailing fractional zero, no binary float. Mirrors valuation-common.schema.json so both halves of the repo canonicalize decimals identically. The '-0\.[0-9]*[1-9]' alternative exists because the primary alternative's integer-part group has no way to spell a negative magnitude strictly between -1 and 0; '-0' alone never matches either alternative.

money.description: Amount plus currency, always together. A bare number is never money.

quantity.description: Share count. Exact decimal because fractional shares exist; never a float.

basisPoints.description: Policy threshold in basis points, 100 = 1%. Integer by construction: policy thresholds are chosen, not measured. Computed weights are NOT rounded to bp.

policySentinel.description: An explicit ruling where a number would otherwise sit. null is not a policy.

utcInstant.description: An exact moment. RFC 3339 with a literal Z; local offsets are not accepted.

localDate.description: A calendar day as a human means it. Never widened into a midnight timestamp.

marketSessionDate.description: A trading session, which is not the same thing as a calendar day: it carries the calendar that decides whether the venue was open.

relativePath.description: Structural surface check only ('/'-separated, no leading/trailing slash, no empty segments, no '..', no backslash). Root containment is enforced at runtime, not by this pattern.

artifactRef.description: Content-addressed pointer to a stored artifact (skill output, pack, result). The record carries the reference; the bytes live outside.

jsonPointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer into the same document. Used to mark provisional policy fields without distorting their value shapes.

forbidden.description: A property that must not appear in this branch. Spelled '{not: {}}' rather than the boolean 'false': a boolean subschema makes the validator drop both the instance path and the property name from the error, so the report says only 'False schema does not allow {...}' with no clue which field was wrong.
